name: What are the primary stages of an interior home renovation?

mainEntity.name: What are the primary stages of an interior home renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: A residential remodel typically progresses through five clear phases: design planning, demolition, rough trades, surface finishing, and punch-list completion. After establishing the project scope and protecting surrounding rooms, demolition removes old fixtures, drywall, or flooring. Next comes custom framing alongside plumbing and electrical rough-ins. Once mechanicals pass inspection, crews hang and finish drywall, lay tile or marble, and install trim molding. The final stage involves interior painting, fixture hookups, hardware installation, and a detailed walkthrough to address final adjustments.
acceptedAnswer.description: Remodeling moves through planning and demolition, rough carpentry and mechanical rough-ins, drywall and tile installation, finish trim and painting, and final detailing.
